timeline.summary: NCLT Bengaluru sanctioned the amalgamation of four wholly owned subsidiaries into Kirloskar Electric Company.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹163.57 Cr (+26.7% YoY), net loss ₹0.63 Cr (against a loss of ₹3.85 Cr a year earlier).
Kirloskar Electric reported Q4 FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹163.57 Cr, up 26.7% YoY, and highlighted the completion of a four-subsidiary merger.
Crisil Ratings upgraded Kirloskar Electric's bank loan ratings to CRISIL BB/Stable and A4+ for ₹115.63 Cr facilities.
